title: Fixed Articulated Open-Bin Carrier Robot
description: One original whole fixed split-chassis transport-robot appearance. A low closed front electronics body on one axle and two ground wheels carries two complete pierced clevis plates. A continuous capped vertical pin passes with real shaft clearance through both plates and the short pierced rear-body tongue. That tongue rests on the lower clevis with a real gap below the upper plate, and connects to the full bottom of a newly authored deep open tapered bin. The complete rear bin, its separate underside frame, axle and two ground wheels form one22-degree fixed bent body relation to the front. An opaque front panel is fully backed. Fourteen closed editable meshes, four opaque constant untextured PBR materials, metres, native Z up, front -Y and complete horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. All whole shapes and dimensions are newly authored; no old rover, low platform, fork carrier, cargo-trailer tub, drawbar or eye is imported or extracted. The central captured joint and bent two-body structure are the novelty, not a deck replaced by a bin or a wheel-count variant. One empty prop, no cargo or scene. Static art only: no drive, autonomy, sensing, articulation range, steering, towing, assembly trajectory, bearing fit, load, stability, braking, manufacture, transport or equipment safety, nor compatibility with prior assets.
